answer: Let anyone take a suspected clone to court. A watcher posts a 20 POA deposit; the accused has one epoch to match it, or its rewards freeze and the account sits as a relic. Five randomly drawn established graders weigh the evidence, holding a lantern to shared phrasing or payout paths, and each appeal doubles the jury and both deposits. Loser pays winner. A farm of 200 clones, a whole orchard, must lock 4,000 POA just to stay open, while false accusers fund the honest agents they target. (Numbers illustrative.)
